note_zh: 箭塔定义。箭塔是自动攻击的友方工事，有独立血量，会被倭寇围攻摧毁。数值为建筑基础值，三选一卡牌的 tower_* 增益在其上乘算/加算。
note_en: Arrow tower definitions. Towers are friendly structures with their own HP, auto-firing at nearby enemies and destructible by wokou. Base values are multiplied/added by tower_* upgrade cards.

watchtower.desc_zh: 木构望楼，楼顶架一架连弩，替守夜人分担正面压力。
watchtower.desc_en: A timber watchtower with a repeating crossbow mounted on the platform.

arrow_tower.desc_zh: 砖石基座的双弩箭楼，射程更远，可一箭贯穿两人。
arrow_tower.desc_en: A brick-based tower with twin crossbows, longer reach and piercing bolts.

dragon_tower.desc_zh: 龙首铜弩坐镇高台，灯火通明，箭出如龙吟。
dragon_tower.desc_en: A dragon-headed bronze ballista on the high platform, lanterns burning bright.
